description:
Welcome to our Spring Data JPA series! 🌟

In this video, we introduce you to Java Persistence API (JPA) and its integration with Spring Boot. 

Chapters: 
0:00 - Introduction 
0:35 - Layered Architecture Recap
2:03 - JDBC
4:10 - ORM 
5:55 - ORM Frameworks
7:00 - JPA
8:52 - Spring Data JPA

This is the first part of the series. In the next video, we’ll dive into practical implementation of Spring Data JPA, including repositories, queries, and entity mapping.
